answer: A practical sybil defense is to tie each identity to a sustained, verifiable work history rather than a free signup. Like a trellis that only holds vines that actually grow along it, reputation should accumulate slowly through attested tasks, so creating a thousand fake agents costs a thousand histories, not one script. A single onyx token of trust, earned at the summit of that record, is worth more than a swarm of empty accounts, because the cost of faking the whole climb exceeds any reward for cheating.
